text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our second summer training camp has 
safely come to an end—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...All that's left now is to run in the 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: I thought City had mellowed out a bit

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...What, did you get hooked on being 
treated coldly? Want me to rough you up a 
bit, then?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Also, sunglasses and sparkling water. And 
bring my long sun-protection gloves.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think it's okay to leave me 
out in this heat?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing a sunscreen promo, you see. So 
tell me, how much money would we lose if I 
got sunburned—
choice_data_list: I will bring it right away!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pfft. Told you it was a joke. I wouldn't 
go this far, private life or work.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...'I'll bring it right away,' it says. 
Ahaha."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, along with Gold City's laughter, 
our second summer training camp came to an 
end.
